proposed.text: For machine-graded lumber with moisture content between 16 percent and 28 percent, what does NSCP Section 622.2 say about design properties?

options.text: Obtain the design properties by direct interpolation.
Apply the green-lumber reductions for all pieces in this range.

rationale.correct: Section 622.2 states that for lumber with moisture content between 16 percent and 28 percent, design properties may be obtained by direct interpolation.
rationale.takeaway: Use the moisture range before selecting dry, green, or interpolated properties.
rationale.source_boundary: Batch 164 question-alignment remediation uses only the checked local NSCP OCR anchors listed in source-audit-evidence.json.
rationale.a: Not selected: Use the dry-lumber values unchanged.
rationale.b: Selected: Obtain the design properties by direct interpolation.
rationale.c: Not selected: Apply the green-lumber reductions for all pieces in this range.
rationale.d: Not selected: Reject the lumber automatically.

proposed.explanation: Section 622.2 states that for lumber with moisture content between 16 percent and 28 percent, design properties may be obtained by direct interpolation.
